## $0000 `ir_cliff_back_player_north_strip_active`

Index 0, byte `$0A00` mask `$01`, D1 scene scratch, scope: scenes $1E, grade **VERIFIED-RUNTIME**.

ir1E_cliff_slide_trigger copies 'player is north of Y $0110' into this scratch bit; once both statues are on the mantels it sets the bit for good.

- **Set:** Set while playerYPos is below $0110 and, after $30 and $31 are both set, unconditionally. The player idle, ladder and shimmy-detach code branches on this bit (player_character.asm:232 {181375} and seven more rows) to pick an alternate sprite variant (the labels read IdleStand*Shadow; the sprite itself is not decoded).
- **Clear:** Cleared by ir1E_cliff_slide_trigger on every frame in which playerYPos is $0110 or more and the statues are not both placed.
- **Runtime:** FR21_20261105: FL22-02 set: Scratch $00 in scene $1E is set while the player's Y is below the north threshold (player Y word $09A4 = 144 and 240 set it) and cleared at Y 496; with $30 and $31 both ... | clear: Follows the player's Y (cleared at Y 496 when $30/$31 are not both set). (O)
- **Queue:** FL22-02

The reader is the same idle-sprite selector that FL20 records for scene $01 (sc_town_player_south_strip_active); the eight player_character rows and shadow_shimmer were not re-read here, so the visible effect stays INFERRED. scene_flag_init also sets $00 in scenes $15, $1A and $1D; that is FL31's open question.
